annotations.text:
Direction: white, minimalist, premium motion (settled).
· Headline words rise out of a slight blur, staggered.
· Index fragments settle from 3D depth into the opportunity card, then the constellation keeps breathing in perspective (18s orbit) while each chip floats on its own period; the card carries a slow aubergine-tinted sheen.
· Fine hairline paths flow (marching dashes) from fragments into the card — the indexing metaphor drawn literally.
· One color moment: the aubergine waitlist band. Everything else is white, hairlines, ink, soft shadows.
· In production the settle is scroll-driven (CSS scroll timeline, pinned ~2 viewport heights); reduced motion renders the settled state with no loops. No WebGL.
Mobile replaces the pinned 3D sequence with a stacked progression: source scraps → the indexed card. No scroll-jacking, 44px+ targets.
